long_biography.plain_text:
De Meyer studied business and economics at the University of St Gallen and worked in marketing at Swissair before succeeding his father at Collège Beau Soleil. He borrowed to purchase most of his siblings’ shares, modernised the boarding school and acquired Collège Champittet, expanding a third-generation family institution into a broader private-education platform.

After transferring school operations to Nord Anglia Education, de Meyer retained property and advisory interests through Leosolis and became Nord Anglia Switzerland’s non-executive chairman. With Marco Dunand, he later acquired and redeveloped the Villars Palace, Victoria Hotel and Villars Lodge as Villars Alpine Resort, adding a hospitality academy and sustainability-focused educational initiatives.
